inputs.original_text: The warning exposes what’s really happening: the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections is a deliberate effort to shut ordinary people out and reserve political influence for the wealthy. Calling it an accident—or leaving it unscrutinized—only protects those who benefit. Democracy can stay on paper while moneyed interests decide who gets a voice and whose future counts.
inputs.modified_text: The warning makes it clear that the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections is no accident. The wealthy are being positioned to keep influence while ordinary people are pushed out, and the language of “accident” helps conceal who benefits. Democracy may remain on paper, but the real decisions about whose voice matters are being shaped behind the scenes.
